note.title: The Trojan Horse
note.overview: Ulysses orders the Greeks to build a wooden horse and sail away. The Trojans drag the horse within Troy’s walls and celebrate.
learningGoals: Recall the taught forms and facts independently.
Apply them to translation and GCSE-style questions.
Use the answer and individual mark points to improve precision.
summary: Ulysses orders the Greeks to build a wooden horse and sail away. The Trojans drag the horse within Troy’s walls and celebrate.
At midnight, while the Trojans sleep, the hidden Greeks climb down and open the gates. The other Greeks enter; very many Trojans are killed.
Aeneas escapes with his family and images of the gods. Retain both details. Read plurimos as very many, without inventing an exact number or saying every Trojan died.

quickCheck.question: Line 1: Who killed Hector?
quickCheck.stimulus:
The Trojan Horse · classroom adaptation

1. Achilles Hectorem necavit sed Graeci victoriam non habebant. Ulixes consilium cepit.
2. iussit Graecos equum ligneum aedificare et Troia navigare.
3. Troiani equum in muros Troiae trahebant. vinum bibebant et gratias deis agebant.
4. media nocte dum Troiani dormiunt, Graeci de equo descenderunt et portas aperuerunt.
5. ceteri Graeci per portas veniebant. plurimos Troianos necaverunt.
6. Aeneas cum familia et simulacris deorum Troia effugit.

Vocabulary: Ulixes = Odysseus / Ulysses; consilium cepit = formed a plan; iussit = ordered; ligneum = wooden; Troia = from Troy; gratias agebant = were giving thanks; media nocte = at midnight; descenderunt = climbed down; aperuerunt = opened; ceteri = the rest of; plurimos = very many; simulacris = images / statues; effugit = escaped

The Trojan Horse · classroom adaptation

1. Achilles Hectorem necavit sed Graeci victoriam non habebant. Ulixes consilium cepit.
2. iussit Graecos equum ligneum aedificare et Troia navigare.
3. Troiani equum in muros Troiae trahebant. vinum bibebant et gratias deis agebant.
4. media nocte dum Troiani dormiunt, Graeci de equo descenderunt et portas aperuerunt.
5. ceteri Graeci per portas veniebant. plurimos Troianos necaverunt.
6. Aeneas cum familia et simulacris deorum Troia effugit.

Vocabulary: Ulixes = Odysseus / Ulysses; consilium cepit = formed a plan; iussit = ordered; ligneum = wooden; Troia = from Troy; gratias agebant = were giving thanks; media nocte = at midnight; descenderunt = climbed down; aperuerunt = opened; ceteri = the rest of; plurimos = very many; simulacris = images / statues; effugit = escaped
